# pidginhost_domain_nameservers (Resource)

The name servers of a domain registered with PidginHost. The domain service must be active. Destroying the resource only removes it from the Terraform state: the domain keeps its name servers. Activating FreeDNS with pidginhost_dns_zone changes the name servers too: do not manage the same domain with both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_domain_nameservers" "example" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  nameservers = ["ns1.example.net", "ns2.example.net"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, such as example.com.
- `nameservers` (Set of String) Name server host names, two to five. They are compared without case and trailing dot.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Domain name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the name servers of a domain by its name.
terraform import pidginhost_domain_nameservers.example example.com
```
